policy.purpose: Incremental primary-source expansion for fresh county coverage without weakening the existing title/date/source-only and full-story gates.

sources.disable_reason: The official Sutești announcements surface is a broad mixed listing that combines public-consultation notices, fiscal debtor publications, recruitment results, land/pre-emption records, budgets, procurement documents, environment notices, utility notices and direct document/PDF material. The current live discovery ledger examined 12 candidate links and recorded 10 article failures. LOCAL NEWS OS must not treat a listing item, document wrapper, file name or document-internal date as a trustworthy article published_at, so this source is disabled from automatic title + date + source projection until a deterministic article-feed subset can be proven.

sources.core_feedback: No Sutești-specific parser is justified. This reinforces the existing ARTICLE_FEED versus DOCUMENT_REGISTER/PDF_FEED boundary and the generic health signal that persistently high article-failure ratios should trigger structural-eligibility review without changing source authority or publication gates.
